column1: Luis Arraez leads the slate with elite hit probability, batting leadoff at home with a strong track record of consistency and a favorable lefty-on-righty matchup against Brandon Sproat. CJ Abrams offers another reliable option, showing excellent recent form and benefiting from a park boost and platoon edge. Ernie Clement and Elly De La Cruz also carry platoon advantages, but Arraez’s steady production and high rate of games with a hit make him the clear top choice for Beat The Streak.
